With the opponent having lost life this turn, a Hired Claw +1/+1 counter activation would provide permanent board improvement, and holding Lightning Strike preserves crucial removal for incoming threats like Appa or Doc Aurlock.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Lightning Strike at opponent's face for 3 damage (12 → 9)
annotations.betterLine: Activate a Hired Claw's +1/+1 counter ability ({1}{R}) to permanently grow it to 2/3, and hold Lightning Strike as removal for opponent's future threats.

annotations.description: Playing Floodfarm Verge instead of Temple Garden limits development this turn. Temple Garden (entering untapped for 2 life) would provide {G} alongside Hallowed Fountain's {U}, enabling an immediate Doc Aurlock cast - a key enabler that makes spells from exile cost {2} less, synergizing perfectly with Appa's airbend ability. With Floodfarm Verge, green mana requires paying 1 life from Starting Town anyway, and Doc Aurlock can't be cast this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Floodfarm Verge as the land drop for the turn
annotations.betterLine: Play Temple Garden (paying 2 life to enter untapped), then cast Doc Aurlock, Grizzled Genius using Temple Garden for {G} and Hallowed Fountain for {U}, establishing a key synergy piece for the Appa game plan
